integrity: The structural proof, stated enumeration, and standalone checker are included. Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to one-edge subdivisions of K_{p,q} with p,q>=3; no formula claimed for smaller parts, multiple subdivisions or other bases. Finite checks support but do not establish the infinite theorem. Indexed searches do not exclude all equivalent literature.
title: Zero-forcing polynomial and minimal forts of single-edge-subdivided complete bipartite graphs
